scripts.dev:worker: pnpm build && wrangler dev .output/server/index.mjs --assets .output/public --config wrangler.jsonc --env local --local
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env local --local
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm build && wrangler deploy .output/server/index.mjs --assets .output/public --config wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.upload:production: pnpm build && wrangler versions upload .output/server/index.mjs --assets .output/public --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm build && wrangler deploy .output/server/index.mjs --assets .output/public --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
